statement: NVIDIA claims Spectrum-X Ethernet Photonics delivers 5x higher power efficiency and up to 95% network efficiency across deployments exceeding 100,000 GPUs.
why: Power efficiency at the fabric layer determines how many GPUs fit inside a fixed power envelope, so gains here effectively expand deployable compute per megawatt.

impact.mechanism: Lower networking power draw per unit of bandwidth frees power budget for accelerators, raising usable GPU density in power-constrained sites.

evidence.excerpt: up to 95% network efficiency across deployments exceeding 100,000 GPUs; a 1.7x reduction in switches needed for data centers; 5x higher power efficiency for Spectrum-X Ethernet Photonics

confidence.basis: Primary source but vendor-marketing performance claims without an independent benchmark or stated baseline configuration.
